create_Mlp_instance: create an Mlp instance with specified input features and hidden layer size
create_Mlp_with_custom_activation: create an Mlp instance using a custom activation layer like ReLU instead of GELU
run_Mlp_forward: run the Mlp forward pass on a PyTorch tensor to get transformed output
create_Mlp_with_dropout: create an Mlp instance with dropout regularization to prevent overfitting
review_Mlp_forward: review the Mlp forward method to understand the fc1-act-drop-fc2-drop computation flow
